title: Node admission atomic integration with announce persistence
description: Child 2 of ta0c decomposition (Rust). Integrate child 1's durable store into Node admission: AnnounceProcessor (rust/lichen-node/src/announce.rs:96-284) pin insert/eviction and seen-table origin sequence floors must commit to the store atomically with the in-memory admission decision (persist-before-apply ordering consistent with spec GCP-6.5 persist-first precedent); eviction must respect durable state (an evicted IID's pin/floor survives restart; re-admission restores from store); DaoOriginValidator must source pre-pinned origin identities from the same store so DAO origin auth and Announce TOFU share one trust base. Fail closed: admission must not mutate route/gradient state if the durable commit fails.
close_reason: Integrated child-1 durable AnnounceTrustStore into Node admission. AnnounceProcessor now holds a shared Rc<RefCell<AnnounceTrustStore>> (clone-shared so the receive-path staged-commit pattern keeps persisting); process() enforces the durable pin (KeyChangeDetected) and sequence floor (StaleSeqNum) and commits to the store persist-first (spec GCP-6.5) before any gradient/pin/seen mutation, fail-closed with new AnnounceRejectReason::PersistenceError; pinned_pubkey_for gains a durable fallback so Announce TOFU and DAO origin admission (receive.rs gate, node.rs handle_dao, admit_dao_origin) share one trust base; evicted/restarted pins survive durably and re-admission restores them. Ephemeral default (AnnounceProcessor::new) is byte-for-byte the previous behavior (store consulted only when persistent), preserving the ephemeral retry/eviction contract. Gateway new_persistent opens AnnounceTrustStore::persistent(state_root, rollback_floor_root, sealing_seed) and Gateway::new stays ephemeral; new GatewayOpenError::AnnounceTrustStorage variant. Also fixed the broken lib.rs duplicate re-export (nonexistent AnnouncePinFloor) left by merge 54e2c2cc5b which made lichen-node uncompilable. Tests: 3 new integration tests (durable commit failure fail-closed incl. gradient untouched, eviction respects durable pin+floor + restart restore, foreign-seal corruption fails closed); full lichen-node suite 288 passed + lichen-gateway all suites green; clippy clean on touched files; fmt clean. Pre-existing failure secure_block1... verified at base and filed as project-LICHEN-worker6-cvko. 3x review filed 6 beads: capacity brick (project-LICHEN-worker6-...), relay-failure seq burn, snapshot/durable divergence, seed zeroize hygiene, test temp-dir leak, pre-existing secure_block1.
